item.title: Mercury 2.5: 1107 tok/s Is Inception's Number, 770 Is the Independent One
item.description: Inception's diffusion LLM Mercury 2.5 hit HN: officially 1107 tok/s, 260K context, launch discount at $0.04/$0.15. Artificial Analysis independently measured 770.4 tok/s (2nd of 184 models) and a 12-point intelligence score (median). Both numbers are true — the measurement gap is the point.

item.title: Qwen-Image-2.1 Is Out: 7B Does It All — Generation, Editing, Transparency — But the License Changed
item.description: On Sept 20, Qwen open-sourced Qwen-Image-2.1: a 7B model that unifies text-to-image, multi-reference editing, and native RGBA transparency in one checkpoint, with up to 10 reference images. On HN the architecture barely got discussed — the license and the 33.1 GB download did.

item.title: Just 'Know Python' on Your Resume? Hiring Managers Aren't Buying It in 2026
item.description: The 2026 Python job market has changed: writing scripts isn't enough anymore. This guide breaks down 9 Python skill areas that actually impress interviewers, with a 4-phase learning roadmap and salary benchmarks.
